The '''''Mandator III''-class dreadnought''' was a [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]]-scale [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], as well as the third class of [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] developed under the [[Mandator-class Star Dreadnaught|''Mandator'']] series, alongside the [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnought]].

==Description==
The ''Mandator III''-class was based on the [[Mandator-class Star Dreadnaught|''Mandator''-class]] and [[Mandator II-class Star Dreadnaught/Legends|''Mandator II''-class Star Dreadnaughts]]. Unlike the [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnought]], another ''Mandator'' successor design, the ''Mandator III''-class dreadnought was specifically designed to be a hulking weapons platform and was both longer and more heavily armed than its predecessors and its contemporary "cousin", featuring shields that rivalled that of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Executor-class]]. At 12,000 meters in length, it was essentially a scaled-up version of the ''Mandator''s.<ref name="JFT" />

==History==
The ''Mandator III''-class was one of several heavy [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] classes made after the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]]. Several participated in the campaign leading up to the [[Imperial Civil War]].
During the in-fighting, one of these vessels, the ''[[Panthac]]'', was destroyed in battle with the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Whelm]]''. Its sister-ship, the ''[[Aculeus]]'', was destroyed by squadrons of [[TIE/D automated starfighter]]s.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
In Jason Fry's Endnotes, he explained that the out-of-universe reason for the different scales between the ''Mandator III'' and the ''Bellator'' was because the text and art for the famous humpbacked starship in ''Dark Empire'', when including the vessel in ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', were given separate numbers without consultation, and thus resulted in an accidential combined design.<ref name="JFT" />

In addition, according to Ansel Hsiao on Stardestroyer.net forums around the time ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' was released, both he and Jason Fry planned to make all the ''Mandator''-series, in addition to the ''Bellator''-class, humpbacked vessels similar to the one that appeared in ''Dark Empire'', although nothing of the sort made it into the final cut by the time of its release.<ref name="Mandator humpbacked">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=1600|text=Something big - Page 65|work=stardestroyer.net|archivedate=20200326203436}}</ref> However, the intended humpbacked hulls of the ''Mandator''-series was nonetheless implied in Jason Fry's endnotes for the book.
